Handy Exact Conversions

UnitEquals
1 inch2.54 cm (exact)
1 mile1.609344 km (exact)
1 pound0.45359237 kg (exact)
1 US gallon3.785411784 L (exact)

Temperature

°F = °C × 9/5 + 32. So 22.2°C = 72°F, and 0°C = 32°F. To go the other way, °C = (°F − 32) × 5/9: 72°F = 22.2°C.

Watch for US vs. Imperial Units

  • The US gallon (3.785 L) is smaller than the imperial gallon (4.546 L).
  • US fluid ounces differ slightly from imperial ones.
  • The "ton" can mean short ton (2,000 lb, US), long ton or metric tonne.

NIST publishes official conversion factors for the US. For measuring materials, see the concrete calculator; for running speeds, the pace calculator.

extra_faqs.q: How many centimeters are in an inch?
How do I convert pounds to kilograms?
extra_faqs.a: Multiply pounds by 0.45359237. For example, 150 lb is about 68.04 kg.

extra_faqs.q: Why are US and UK gallons different?
extra_faqs.a: They come from different historical definitions: the US gallon is based on the old wine gallon, and the imperial gallon on the volume of 10 pounds of water.
